The rains here are not always kind, and I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or spray medicines. I will plant my usual seeds that I keep from last harvest, mix them together on the plot like I always do, and put the cow manure I have from my animals. My sons and wife will help me work the land by hand, because hiring people costs money I do not have.
